machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

method.reference: Pinned official Diffusers transformer with BF16 weights and activations on MPS
method.native: FP32 activations, BF16 dense weights, affine-Q8/group-64 selected tail matrices
method.prompts: real prompt-encoder outputs from the established quantization calibration cases
method.latents: deterministic seeded Gaussian inputs rounded to BF16 before fixture export

acceptance.metric: worst production-scale target-output normalized RMS versus pinned BF16 Diffusers

interpretation: The production gate deliberately measures the complete native arithmetic path, not quantization in isolation. Native FP32 activations diverge from the official BF16 execution before the mixed-Q8 tail: the largest sampled pre-tail value is 2.29327% at block 15 in the 512-pixel case. The separate policy search retains its 1% quantization-only gate.
limitations: Summed GPU time is not wall time; every kernel uses a separate command buffer and synchronous wait.
Declared working bytes cover explicit Metal buffers and exclude the mapped packed weights, Metal driver bookkeeping, and pipeline objects.
These are independent single-step noise predictions, not a scheduler-integrated denoising trajectory.
Prompt embeddings are precomputed; the native prompt encoder is a later boundary.
